content:
marco: Who's up for a 10-minute stair sprint at 5pm? casual, no pressure.
tess: lol sign me up. need to beat my lunchtime time.
ben: count me in. i'll bring the stopwatch app.
ali: can someone save a spot on the roof for cooldown?
facilities-bot: Reminder: stairwell use after 4:30 requires quiet shoes and no more than 6 people at once.
marco: plan: meet by the north stairwell at 4:55, two heats of 3, easy jog down to recover.
tess: i'll bring a banana and spare water.
ben: small wager: loser buys post-work smoothies? :smirk: 
ali: you're on. also please keep it low-key — last time we got a complaint about thunderous footsteps.
marco: low-impact push-off, agreed. see y'all 4:55.
